attributes.title: WSU Veterinary Spring Conference 2027
attributes.venue: WSU College of Veterinary Medicine (Veterinary Teaching Hospital and Bustad Hall)
attributes.organizer: Washington State University College of Veterinary Medicine
attributes.summary:
Washington State University's College of Veterinary Medicine holds its Spring Conference April 2 to 4, 2027 on the Pullman campus. Friday evening, April 2, is optional and features the Bustad Lecture at 5:30 p.m.; the main CE program runs over the weekend.

There are large animal, small animal and technician tracks, and the college invites veterinarians, technicians and assistants. Sessions are held in the Veterinary Teaching Hospital, Bustad Hall and the Animal Disease Biotechnology Facility. Some labs are limited to one group and to 22 to 24 seats, so they need advance registration. The page lists 12 CE credits.

The page still showed 2026 prices ($325 early for veterinarians, $200 early for technicians), so expect 2027 fees to be posted later. Questions go to CVME@vetmed.wsu.edu.
